caveats: LEVERAGE-REGIME MIX: BDC 150% coverage and non-1940-Act wrappers allow materially more leverage than 1940-Act funds. Fee bases and return volatility are not like-for-like. [per product from the record: AMG Pantheon Fund, LLC: 1940-Act asset-coverage limits, Ares Private Markets Fund: 1940-Act asset-coverage limits, Hamilton Lane Private Assets Fund: 1940-Act asset-coverage limits, KKR Private Equity Conglomerate LLC: no 1940-Act leverage limits (34-Act conglomerate), StepStone Private Markets: 1940-Act asset-coverage limits]

LIQUIDITY-LAW MIX: Rule 23c-3 obligations, discretionary tenders, and repurchase plans give different worst-case exit rights. Cadence numbers alone overstate comparability. [by wrapper type: AMG Pantheon Fund, LLC: board-DISCRETIONARY tender offers (nothing compels the next one), Ares Private Markets Fund: board-DISCRETIONARY tender offers (nothing compels the next one), Hamilton Lane Private Assets Fund: board-DISCRETIONARY tender offers (nothing compels the next one), KKR Private Equity Conglomerate LLC: board-discretionary share repurchases, StepStone Private Markets: board-DISCRETIONARY tender offers (nothing compels the next one)]
